The median age of a first-time home buyer in the US is 40.

statements.text:
AI and Crypto have recently started funneling money into our elections, but dark money has influenced our politics for far too long.

I introduced the Democracy for All Amendment because people, not corporate interests, should decide elections.

https://t.co/1ClhIfeio5

Why has the GOP gone MIA when we’re facing an AI threat? As warnings from its creators about the AI threat to our very existence have multiplied, Speaker Johnson has decided that Congress will be on vacation for the next 7 weeks. I joined 107 Democratic colleagues in demanding that Congress meet NOW in order to address the AI threat.
statements.quoted:
Our letter to Speaker Johnson was clear: the House should remain in session until Congress advances meaningful, bipartisan AI safeguards.

Speaker Johnson is fiddling in this firestorm, but at least Nero had the decency to stay in town while Rome burned. https://t.co/Zye2zg2Ui0
